title: test/cli-tracker-process.test.ts:616: a 1000ms wall-clock bound flakes under load (measured 1070ms)
description: The test asserts performance.now() - started < 1000 for a spawned quest invocation. On a loaded machine it measured 1070.227ms and failed, which cost a review attempt on QCLI-283: review-assignment attempt 1 returned outcome "findings" with that red, and opum-control then REFUSED to record the otherwise-approved review because a machine-derived approve is refused when the envelope outcome is not "pass". The file is untouched by that change, the same revision passed standalone (28 pass / 0 fail), and this PR CI source-gates was green on that sha. A wall-clock upper bound on a process spawn is load-sensitive by construction. Fix direction: raise or remove the bound, or assert on an outcome that does not depend on machine load. Filed by the quest-cli worker at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The timing assertion at test/cli-tracker-process.test.ts:616 no longer fails solely because the machine is loaded -- the 1000ms wall-clock bound is raised, removed, or replaced by a load-independent assertion -- with the measured 1070.227ms recorded as the repro.
